result.note: Tests the composition, mandate and timeline of the Union government's new committee on demographic change, announced in May 2026.

questions.prompt: In May 2026, the Union government constituted a high-level committee to study demographic changes caused by illegal immigration and other 'unnatural' reasons. Consider the following statements about it:
items: The committee is headed by a retired Supreme Court judge.
It is tasked with recommending a permanent mechanism for the identification, detention and deportation of illegal immigrants.
It has been directed to submit its report within six months.
questions.ask: How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 3 is wrong because the committee has one year to report, and six months is only the possible extension. The panel, headed by retired Supreme Court judge Prakash Prabhakar Navlekar, will also propose measures on border management, national security and population stabilisation.
questions.source: The group has been directed to submit its comprehensive report and recommendations within one year, with a potential extension of up to six months if necessary.
